subject: Re: Deployment gating — network & KMS validation
messages:
From: Linh Tran <linh.tran@lumina-fin.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Cc: ops@lumina-fin.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lumina pre-prod gate: network & KMS details

Hi Olga / Marcus,

Thanks again for the walkthrough this morning. As we confirm our go/no-go for the pre-prod handoff, ops asked me to circulate the items they need validated from a networking and KMS perspective. Attached is our current network diagram and a draft of our KMS key policy. Can you confirm the red lines below?

Key asks from Lumina ops (short):
- Confirm supported MTU/path MTU settings across the transit path (we see occasional fragmentation on large model artifacts).
- BGP session adjacency and AS prep: provide expected peer IPs and prefixes so we can pre-provision BGP filters.
- Firewall egress: list IP ranges and TCP/UDP ports the Redwood runtime will call out to (including telemetry, CRLs, and OS patch mirrors).
- KMS: confirm whether Redwood can join our external KMS (AWS KMS multi-account) or if we must use a Redwood-managed CMK. Include key rotation window and audit export cadence.
- Time sync: NTP endpoints allowed and drift SLA.

Quick timeline: we are targeting environment validation the week of Dec 7. If you can provide the checklist confirmations by EOD Dec 1, that would keep us on track.

Attachments: lumina-infra-network-diagram.vsdx, kms-key-policy-draft.json

Thanks,
Linh
Site Reliability Lead — Lumina Financial

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Linh Tran <linh.tran@lumina-fin.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumina pre-prod gate: network & KMS details

Linh —

Appreciate the clear list. I pulled together the Redwood gating checklist for network + KMS validation and annotated items below. High level answers first, then a short action table.

Top-level: we can meet the Dec 7 validation target, contingent on two quick items we need from Lumina ops by EOD Dec 1:
1) Confirmation of the BGP peer IPs (public/private depending on transit) so we can pre-configure our routers.
2) The IAM principal (ARN) you intend Redwood to use if you want us to integrate with your AWS KMS key; otherwise we will provide a Redwood-managed CMK.

Redwood answers (summary):
- MTU: We recommend 1500 across the transit and will enable PMTU discovery; if you need jumbo frames (9001) we can accommodate but will require validation on both sides.
- BGP: Our runbook supports both eBGP and iBGP to a transit gateway. We'll provide expected AS and sample filters.
- Firewall egress: outbound IP ranges: 34.210.0.0/16, 52.12.0.0/16 and port list: TCP 443, TCP 80 (for OS patches), UDP 123 (NTP), TCP 22 (optional debug by request). We also send telemetry on TCP 15000 (encrypted).
- KMS: We support both external customer-managed KMS (we call that BYOK) and Redwood-managed CMK. If BYOK, key policy must allow redwood-inference-root@redwood (ARN: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodKMS). Rotation: 30 days optional; audit exports daily.
- NTP: We require NTP reachable to time.google.com (ip: 216.239.35.0/24 acceptable); drift tolerance <= 2s for TLS cert validation.

Action items (owners / due):
- Lumina: provide BGP peer IPs and KMS IAM principal (Linh) — due 2026-12-01 EOD.
- Redwood: produce final env-validation checklist (.xlsx) and a hardened KMS key policy template (Olga) — due 2026-12-01 noon PT.
- Redwood: share sample iptables/egress ACL snippets (Marcus) — due 2026-12-01 EOD.

I've attached an environment validation checklist template (env-validation-checklist.xlsx) — please review and mark entries "Lumina ready" vs "Redwood to implement".

If anything here looks off, call me direct — 415-555-0189.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Manager, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: env-validation-checklist.xlsx]

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, Linh Tran <linh.tran@lumina-fin.com>
Cc: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumina pre-prod gate: network & KMS details

Adding a few low-level notes from infra before Olga finalizes:

- We will publish a small BGP peer snippet (ASN, peer IPs, and advertise/receive filters). Expect that in the next 4 hours.
- On MTU: if Lumina prefers jumbo frames for artifact transfer, we need confirmation of path MTU across interconnects (including any partner fabric) — otherwise default to 1500 and enable TCP MSS clamping.
- Egress IPs: I'll also provide a short-lived CIDR allowlist file for your firewall team to drop in (we rotate internal infra IPs; we'll give you an explicit snapshot for the handoff).
- KMS: if you go BYOK, please note Redwood will not store plaintext key material; we'll call Encrypt/Decrypt via the AWS KMS API from the VPC endpoint. We'll need a KMS grant that allows the role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/RedwoodKMS to use Decrypt/Encrypt and GenerateDataKey.

I'll attach the early drafts. Marcus

[Attachment: kms-key-policy-draft.json]

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Linh Tran <linh.tran@lumina-fin.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumina pre-prod gate: network & KMS validation — checklist ready

Linh / team —

Thanks for the quick responses. I uploaded the completed env-validation-checklist.xlsx with our cells filled and a short "Redwood notes" column (see Drive link below). Highlights and next steps:

- Completed: Firewall egress snapshot, NTP endpoints, telemetry ports.
- Pending (Lumina input required): BGP peer IPs, KMS principal ARN, and confirmation on MTU policy.
- Security note: we've flagged an item to require SOC2 audit export of KMS access logs during the validation window — please confirm that's acceptable on your end.

Next meeting: propose Dec 3 10:00 PT for a 30-min gating call to walk the checklist items that are pending. If you can resolve the two EOD Dec 1 deliverables that Olga requested, we can keep that slot as a quick sync.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bC_network-onprem-lumina

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Cloud Operations — Redwood Inference
